description: Connect a whole organization once, approved by its admin, instead of each person signing in. action start_microsoft (tenant optional): an admin consent link for a Microsoft 365 Global Administrator. start_google (domain, adminEmail): the client id and scopes a Workspace super admin pastes into Domain-wide delegation. list / get; verify: check access by reading the directory; users: the organization's people; update: label, brand; delete: confirm:true. Answers 'not switched on yet' where this server is not set up for it. Admin only. Free.
name: manage_org_connections
title: Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace organization connections
